title: Generate Parentheses
statement: Given `n`, return every string of `n` pairs of well-formed parentheses, sorted lexicographically (`(` sorts before `)`).
hints: Generating all 2^(2n) strings and filtering is wasteful. When is adding '(' legal? When is ')'?
Add '(' while opened < n; add ')' while closed < opened.
Backtrack with counts of opened and closed. Trying '(' before ')' produces lexicographic order directly.
